name: BTC active addresses rising + momentum — organic-demand-confirmed uptrend (spot long)
rationale: MECHANISM (why on-chain activity leads price): unique active Bitcoin addresses per day is a direct read on REAL network demand — actual wallets transacting, an axis orthogonal to price/funding/sentiment. An uptrend backed by rising organic on-chain usage is demand-driven and durable; an uptrend on flat on-chain activity is a hollow, speculative drift. On-chain adoption tends to build ahead of sustained price appreciation (users arrive, then price follows), giving activity a lead. We require btc_active_addresses above a fitted floor AND positive ret_Nd, and ride it, exiting when activity rolls over. (BTC on-chain is a market-wide read broadcast across the crypto universe.) DISCONFIRMER 1: if plain momentum without the on-chain gate matches the deflated Sharpe, activity adds nothing. DISCONFIRMER 2 (non-stationarity): active-address counts drift over years, so a fitted absolute floor risks being always-true — the Gate's deflated Sharpe must reject a degenerate level; the edge must be the activity regime, not the trend in the counter. Data knowable T+1. tier1, low-confidence OOS.
catalyst: btc_active_addresses is above a fitted floor (network usage elevated) while price momentum is positive.
